question: Which of the following steps correctly describes how to move a file or folder using the Cut and Paste method?

options.text: Select file → Press Ctrl + C → Go to new location → Press Delete
Select file → Right-click → Copy → Go to new location → Right-click → Paste
Select file → Edit → Cut or Ctrl + X → Go to new location → Edit → Paste or Ctrl + V
Open file → Click Close → Open Recycle Bin

solution:
The correct answer is __**3) Select file → Edit → Cut or Ctrl + X → Go to new location → Edit → Paste or Ctrl + V**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Cut and Paste** method is a process used to move files or folders from one location to another within a computer system.
 
• The steps involved in the correct method are:
 
 
• **Select the file or folder** that needs to be moved.
 
• Use the **Edit menu** or press **Ctrl + X** (shortcut for Cut) to remove the file or folder from its current location temporarily.
 
• Navigate to the **new location** where the file or folder is to be moved.
 
• Paste the file or folder in the new location using the **Edit menu** or pressing **Ctrl + V** (shortcut for Paste).</li&g
